title: Tests that read this repository instead of a fixture red whenever the estate is mid-flight
body: `lifecycle_verbs_edit_the_list` and `facade_acceptance::a_no_op_scope_change_is_reported_rather_than_written_twice` name `intent/.canon/st/ST0056.json` and `intent/st/ST0056/**` in their failures (dc and vc, 2026-09-12). Green again once the estate was consistent, so the class stands unfixed and blames whoever is committing. Each such test moves to a fixture tree; hv's to rule, cc's if ruled. Carried in `intent/wip.md` until 2026-09-13.
